node.title: WCL slot 1,6 emptiness
node.statement: No reduced signed weight-6 polynomial vanishes at an order-512 root at any official row (ell=1 window; (1,6)-shaped relations exist at NON-ambient primes — the v_2(q-1) >= 41 gate is load-bearing). Exact search excludes all relations on the first 64 certified split-prime characteristics q=k*2^41+1 with 3<=k<=996; this finite evidence does not cover later characteristics or extension rows. FALSIFIER: one official-admissible prime (q < 2^256, v_2(q-1) >= 41) carrying the vanisher. Minted 2026-07-19 at the WCL amber ceremony; bookkeeping of record = the zone node's official_terminal_attack.md.
